description: Checks a specific buy-to-let property in England or Wales from its postcode, asking price, type and bedrooms, using live public data: sold prices nearby and a price guide based on them, rent (the area average unless given), true net yield and cashflow, stress tests, crime, flood risk and live warnings, coal mining, planning constraints (conservation areas, Article 4, listed buildings), transport, schools and the local rental market. The postcode is the property's, not the user's location. Returns a 0 to 100 score with its parts, flags, a rule-based summary and a link to the full report. Results are educational estimates, not financial advice. Needs the user to sign in to their RealYield account; takes up to 30 seconds.

agent_fee_pct.description: Letting agent fee as a percentage of rent. Pass 0 if the landlord self-manages.

deposit_pct.description: Deposit as a percentage of the price.

monthly_rent.description: Expected monthly rent in GBP. Omit to use the ONS average for the area and bedroom count.

mortgage_rate.description: Annual mortgage rate as a percentage.

ownership_type.description: Held personally (Section 24 applies) or through a limited company.

postcode.description: Full UK postcode of the property, for example M14 5RF. Partial postcodes are not accepted.

repairs_pct.description: Repairs allowance as a percentage of rent.

service_charge_monthly.description: Monthly service charge in GBP (leasehold flats).

tax_band.description: The landlord's income tax band: basic (20%), higher (40%) or additional (45%).

name: check_deal
title: Check a property listing (Deal Check)
